mapper.select: select (select count(1) from pv_station) as total_stations, cast(ifnull((select sum(capacity_mw) from pv_station), 0) as decimal(12,2)) as total_capacity_mw, (select count(1) from pv_inverter) as total_inverters, (select count(1) from pv_inverter where status = 'online') as online_inverters, cast(ifnull((select sum(current_power) from pv_inverter), 0) as decimal(12,2)) as current_power_kw, cast(ifnull((select sum(daily_yield) from pv_inverter), 0) as decimal(12,2)) as daily_yield_kwh, (select count(1) from pv_alert where status = 'active') as active_alerts

select date_format(collect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') as hour, cast(avg(active_power) as decimal(12,2)) as avg_power_kw from pv_telemetry where collect_time >= #{startTime} group by date_format(collect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') order by hour asc

select r.rule_id, r.level, r.channel_id, r.throttle_sec, c.channel_type, c.target, c.enabled as channel_enabled from pv_alert_rule r inner join pv_alert_channel c on c.channel_id = r.channel_id where r.level = #{level} order by r.rule_id asc
mapper.update: update pv_alert set status = 'resolved', resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, update_by = #{resolvedBy}, update_time = sysdate() where alert_id = #{alertId} and status = 'active'
update pv_alert set status = 'resolved', resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, update_by = #{resolvedBy}, update_time = sysdate() where status = 'active'
